summary: This bill makes a 2019 federal rule concerning health reimbursement arrangements and other account-based group health plans permanent by giving it the full force and effect of law.

scores.thoughts: This bill codifies rules for Health Reimbursement Arrangements (HRAs), which are employer-funded accounts used for healthcare expenses. By making these rules permanent, it supports a system where individuals use employer-provided funds to purchase private health insurance or pay for medical costs, thus leaning towards private healthcare solutions rather than public ones.
